plugins.name: night-shift
plugins.description: Overnight batch runner: queue tasks before bed, a declared auto-approval policy lets safe operations run unattended, ask-tier operations (payment, send-message, publish, purchase) stop with a clear ASK line and 'asked' status, anything risky parks with a reason, and a morning digest reports results grouped by completed, asked, parked, failed. Never pushes, never auto-approves outside the policy.
